rules: All features are computed from records available at the prediction date.
Temporal censoring: only records with period_end <= prediction_date contribute.
Absence of an LMS record is NaN; a true zero means the student had zero activity.
attendance_submission_ratio is attendance / (submission_rate + 1); denominator is never zero.
Unknown outcomes are never used as the negative dropout class.

features.name: attendance_percentage
features.description: Fraction of scheduled classes attended over the lookback window.

features.name: attendance_change_4_weeks
features.description: MoM change in attendance percentage between the two most recent 4-week windows.

features.name: assignment_submission_rate
features.description: Fraction of assigned assessments with a recorded submission.

features.name: late_submission_rate
features.description: Fraction of submitted assessments turned in after the deadline.

features.name: assessment_score_trend
features.description: OLS slope of assessment_score over time over the last 4 weeks.

features.name: weekly_lms_clicks
features.description: Mean daily click count on learning resources.

features.name: lms_activity_change
features.description: MoM change in weekly LMS clicks between the two most recent 4-week windows.

features.name: inactive_days
features.description: Mean number of days with zero resource clicks per week.

features.name: assessment_delay_days
features.description: Mean late-arrival in days for submitted assessments.

features.name: previous_backlog_count
features.description: Failed/repeated courses carried into the current semester.

features.name: semester_progress
features.description: Fraction of the academic year completed at the prediction date.

features.name: attendance_submission_ratio
features.description: Attendance as a ratio of submission rate, with a safe denominator.
